[THALABI:v6p246/r9] THALABI, d. 427 · author | holds | Peace upon those who follow guidance means peace upon whoever submits.

[QUSHAYRI:v2p263/r11] QUSHAYRI, d. 465 · author | holds | Hardness of heart, obstruction in obedience, and losses of wealth or life are forms of immediate punishment.

[QUSHAYRI:v2p263/r7] QUSHAYRI, d. 465 · author | holds | Only a heart illuminated by gnosis follows guidance; one covered by ignorance cannot hear it.
